description: Limite du Grand Port Maritime is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by La Rochelle. Conformément aux dispositions de la loi n° 2008-660 du 4 juillet 2008 portant réforme portuaire, le Grand Port Maritime de La Rochelle est dirigé par un Directoire, agissant, dans son domaine de compétence, sous le contrôle d'un Conseil de Surveillance. Coverage: La Rochelle. The portal shows the English title as "Grand Port Maritime Limit" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is La Rochelle. Its keywords include decoupage, port, maritime, bateau, commerce, transport. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
